## Summary of changes

The issue had two root causes:

1. **The element was reported as "hidden"** because in the headless Chrome environment used by Playwright, text content alone doesn't give a div any rendered height — the wrapper had `height: 0` even though the alert text was in the DOM. Added `style={{ minHeight: '1px' }}` to all four return paths so the wrapper always has a non-zero bounding box.
